changelog:
Initial release of smtp-mail-sender – a command-line SMTP email sending tool with multi-recipient, HTML, and attachment support.

- Provides an interactive setup to configure email credentials (stored in Windows Registry).
- Supports sending plain text and HTML emails, multiple recipients, and attachments via script or Python import.
- Automatically matches common email domains to their corresponding SMTP server settings.
- Allows manual SMTP server/port/mode configuration for unsupported domains.
- Sample command line and Python usage included in documentation.
